en: Sepia-toned street scene showing a gently curving cobblestone street lined with two- and three-storey townhouses and shops. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks and a horse-drawn cart stands in the middle distance. Shop signs are visible on the right, including one reading "Hermann Seifert." At the top of the image, printed text identifies the location as a street in Geithain in Saxony, Germany.
